title: BOV Helen Chao：25万亿分摊五年，能抵消地产调整的拖累吗？
speaker: Helen Chao

segments.en: Now, put the $25 trillion Renminbi rep figure in context for us. How large is that in a greater sense of things?
segments.zh: 请把25万亿元这个数字放在更大的背景下来看，它到底有多大？

segments.en: Well, I would say that, you know, if we're talking about dividing into five years evenly, then about five trillion Renminbi per year, and that's kind of like three to four percentage point of GDP per year.
segments.zh: 如果平均分摊到五年，每年约5万亿元，大致相当于每年GDP的三到四个百分点。

segments.en: But I would say that, you know, within the year, do we see so much kind of delivered? That's the big question mark we don't know, whether the pace would be accelerated at the very beginning, what was the end? We're not still sure.
segments.zh: 但年内能落地多少仍是很大的问号，节奏是前高后低还是后高前低，目前还不确定。

segments.en: But relative to, for example, property, you know, investment, which at a high time probably reached a 10 trillion plus, you know, this is not necessarily comparable in terms of the size, right?
segments.zh: 但相比地产相关配置高峰时可能超过10万亿元的规模，两者在体量上并不完全可比。

segments.en: However, I think that the property investment is much lower now after significant acceleration for five years, and each year the drag is probably smaller, you know, less than two trillion.
segments.zh: 不过，地产相关配置在经历五年明显调整后已大幅回落，每年的拖累可能不到2万亿元。

segments.en: So I would say this is quite helpful in terms of, you know, offsetting the drag from the property investment weakness, as well as the slowdown in local government sponsored infrastructure investment.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，这对于对冲地产相关配置偏弱以及地方政府主导基建放缓的拖累，是相当有帮助的。
